```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(dotenv)
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidyr)
library(ieugwasr)
library(TwoSampleMR)
library(ggplot2)

# Read environment file

readRenviron(here("config.env"))

interim_dir <- Sys.getenv("interimdatadir")
processed_dir <- Sys.getenv("processeddatadir")
resultsdir <- Sys.getenv("docsdir")

drugs_file <- file.path(interim_dir, "teratogenic_drugs.txt")
mapped_file <- file.path(interim_dir, "predicted_outcomes/Primary_Indication_Mapping/Mapped_outcomes.csv")
chosen_openGWAS_dir <- file.path(interim_dir, "predicted_outcomes/Primary_Indication_Mapping/Open_GWAS_Chosen_Outcomes")
targets_file <- file.path(interim_dir, "predicted_outcomes/Drug_Bank_targets/Drug_Bank_targets.csv")
indications_file <- file.path(interim_dir, "reported_outcomes/Drug_Bank_outcomes/Drug_Bank_Indications.csv")
harmonised_dir <- file.path(interim_dir, "predicted_outcomes/Primary_Indication_Mapping/MR_output")
MR_res_dir <- file.path(processed_dir, "Primary_indications_MR_Results")

```


```{r}
#| label: Reading in data
#| include: false

# All drugs
drugs <- readLines(drugs_file)

# Target of each drug
drug_targets <- fread(targets_file) %>% 
  filter(Primary == "Primary")

# Indication of each drug
drug_indications <- fread(indications_file) %>% 
  filter(`Approval Level` == "Prescription")

# Mapped Outcome data
mapped_data <- fread(mapped_file) %>% 
  select("indication", "openGWAS_outcome", "ncase", "ncontrol", "sample_size")

# Chosen openGWAS outcomes
chosen_openGWAS_files <- list.files(chosen_openGWAS_dir, full.names = TRUE)

# Harmonised Exposure and Outcome data (Oriented to the effect of the drug on the target)
harmonised_files <- list.files(harmonised_dir, full.names = TRUE)

# MR Results
MR_res_files <- list.files(MR_res_dir, full.names = TRUE)

# Normalise terminology
drug_targets[which(drug_targets$Drug == "Folic acid"), "Drug"] <- "Folate"
drugs[which(drugs == "Valproate")] <- "Valproic_acid"
drug_indications[which(drug_indications$Drug == "Valproate"), "Drug"] <- "Valproic acid"

```

```{r}
#| label: Functions
#| include: false
#| echo: false

extract_indications <- function(drug){
  indications <- drug_indications %>% 
  filter(Drug == drug)

  indication_list <- paste0("^", paste(indications$Indication, collapse = "$|^"), "$")

  return(list(indications = indications, indication_list = indication_list))
}

extract_all_openGWAS_outcomes <- function(drug, indication_list){
  opengwas_outcomes <- mapped_data
  opengwas_outcomes$indication <- gsub("_", " ", opengwas_outcomes$indication)
    
  opengwas_outcomes <- opengwas_outcomes[grep(indication_list, opengwas_outcomes$indication),] %>% 
    unique()
  
  return(opengwas_outcomes)
}

extract_chosen_openGWAS_outcomes <- function(drug){
  
  studies <- grep(paste0("/", drug, "_"), chosen_openGWAS_files, value = T)
  
  if (length(studies) == 0){
    return(NULL)
  } else{
    
    studies <- studies %>% 
      fread()
    
    outcome_ids <- paste0("^", paste(unique(studies$opengwas_id), collapse = "$|^"), "$")
    
    return(list(openGWAS_studies = studies, outcome_ids = outcome_ids))
  }
}

extract_targets <- function(drug){
  targets <- drug_targets %>%
    filter(Drug == gsub("_", " ", drug)) %>%
    select(c("Target", "Gene_Name", "Action", "Direction")) %>%
    unique()
  
  target_list <- paste0("^", paste(targets$Gene_Name, collapse = "$|^"), "$")
  
  if (nrow(targets) == 0){
    return(NULL)
  } else{
    return(list(targets = targets, target_list = target_list))
  }
}

extract_MR_result <- function(drug, outcome_ids){
  mr_res_all <- grep(paste0("/", drug, "_"), MR_res_files, value = T)
  
  if(length(mr_res_all) == 0){
    return(NULL)
  } else{
    
    mr_res_all <- mr_res_all %>%
      fread()
    
    mr_res <- mr_res_all[grep(outcome_ids, mr_res_all$id.outcome),] %>%
      as.data.frame()
  
  return(mr_res)
  }
}

create_plot_df <- function(mr_res){
  
  # Adjust p values for multiple testing (per outcome)
  mr_res <- mr_res %>%
    group_by(openGWAS_outcome) %>%
    mutate(pval_adj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Align direction of effect to the direction of drug effect on the target
  for(g in unique(mr_res$gene.exposure)){
    drug_direction <- mr_res[which(mr_res$gene.exposure == g), "Direction"] %>%
      unique()
    if(drug_direction == "negative"){
      mr_res[which(mr_res$gene.exposure == g), "b"] <- -1 * mr_res[which(mr_res$gene.exposure == g), "b"]
    }
  }
  
  # Converting to Odds ratio (as are all binary outcomes) and adding CIs
  plot_df <- mr_res %>%
    mutate(
      OR = exp(b),
      lower = exp(b - 1.96 * se),
      upper = exp(b + 1.96 * se),
      outcome = factor(openGWAS_outcome),
      sig = pval_adj < 0.05
    )
  
  # Creating a gene(SNP) column
  plot_df$gene.snp <- paste0(plot_df$gene.exposure, "(", plot_df$SNP, ")")
  
    # Assigning a unique colour to each gene(SNP)
  snps <- unique(plot_df$gene.snp)
  
  gene_cols <- setNames(
    scales::hue_pal()(length(snps)),
    snps
  )
  
  # Only fill significant points
  plot_df$fill_col <- ifelse(
    plot_df$sig,
    gene_cols[plot_df$gene.snp],
    "white"
  )
  
  # Individual plot for each target gene
  genes <- unique(plot_df$gene.exposure)

  return(list(plot_df = plot_df, snps = snps, gene_cols = gene_cols, genes = genes))
}

create_plot <- function(plot_df, g, snps, gene_cols){
      
  df <- subset(plot_df, gene.exposure == g)
    
  # If the drug is an inhibitor of the target, the plot will show decrease in exposure
  effect_direction <- df$Direction %>%
    unique()
    
  if (effect_direction == "negative"){
    x_label <- "Odds Ratio per 1 SD decrease in QTL"
  } else {
    x_label <- "Odds Ratio per 1 SD increase in QTL"
  }
    
    # Plot
  p <- ggplot(
    df,
    aes(
      y = id.exposure,
      x = OR,
      xmin = lower,
      xmax = upper
      )
    ) +
      
    geom_errorbarh(
      aes(colour = gene.snp), 
      height = 0.2
    ) +
      
    geom_point(
      aes(colour = gene.snp),
      shape = 21,
      fill = df$fill_col,
      size = 2
    ) +
      
    geom_vline(
      xintercept = 1,
      linetype = 2
    ) +
      
    scale_x_log10() +
      
    facet_wrap(
      ~openGWAS_outcome,
      scales = "free_x",
      ncol = 2
    ) +
      
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = gene_cols
    ) +
      
    theme_bw() +
      
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8)
    ) +
      
    labs(
      title = g,
      x = x_label,
      y = "Drug Target Measure",
      colour = "Drug Target Measure"
    )

  return(p)
}

extract_sig_SNP <- function(drug, openGWAS_studies){
  
  # Extract harmonised exposure-outcome data
  harmonised_data <- grep(drug, harmonised_files, value = T) %>%
    fread() %>%
    filter(id.outcome %in% unique(openGWAS_studies$opengwas_id)) %>%
    left_join(., openGWAS_studies, by = c("id.outcome" = "opengwas_id"), relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
    select(exposure, SNP, beta.exposure, beta.outcome, pval.exposure, pval.outcome, indication, originalname.outcome, gene.exposure, f, r2, Action, Direction)
  
  # Adjust pvalue for multiple testing (per outcome)
  harmonised_data <- harmonised_data %>%
    group_by(originalname.outcome) %>%
    mutate(
      pval.outcome_adj = p.adjust(pval.outcome, method = "BH")
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
    
  # Filtering for those with a significant effect on outcome
  harmonised_data <- harmonised_data %>%
    mutate(
      sig = pval.outcome_adj < 0.05
    ) %>%
    filter(sig == TRUE)
  
  # Assigning risk due to drug target effect
  harmonised_data$Risk <- ifelse(
    harmonised_data$beta.outcome < 0,
    "Decreased Risk",
    "Increased Risk"
  )
  
  harmonised_data <- harmonised_data[order(harmonised_data$originalname.outcome, harmonised_data$SNP, harmonised_data$Risk),]
  
  # Save
  
  if(nrow(harmonised_data) != 0) {

    return(harmonised_data)

  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
}

```

```{r}
#| label: Drug_Results
#| include: true
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| warning: false
#| message: false

for (drug in drugs) {

  cat("\n\n# ", drug, "\n\n", sep = "")

  cat("\n\n## ", "Primary Indications", "\n\n", sep = "")

  # What are the indications
  indications <- extract_indications(drug)

  if (nrow(indications$indications) == 0) {
    cat("No indications found for ", drug)
    next
  } else{
    cat("\n\n")
    cat(knitr::kable(
      indications$indications,
      caption = paste(gsub("_", " ", drug), "Primary Indications")),
      sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  cat("\n\n## ", "All Mapped openGWAS Outcomes", "\n\n", sep = "")

  ## All Mapped openGWAS Outcomes

  # All mapped openGWAS outcomes for the indications
  opengwas_outcomes <- extract_all_openGWAS_outcomes(drug, indications$indication_list)

  if (nrow(opengwas_outcomes) == 0) {
    cat("No openGWAS outcomes found for ", drug)
    next
  } else{
    cat("\n\n")
    cat(knitr::kable(
      opengwas_outcomes,
      caption = paste(gsub("_", " ", drug), "openGWAS Outcomes")),
      sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  cat("\n\n## ", "Chosen Mapped openGWAS Outcomes", "\n\n", sep = "")

  # Chosen openGWAS outcomes for the indications
  chosen_outcomes <- extract_chosen_openGWAS_outcomes(drug)

  if(is.null(chosen_outcomes)){
    cat("No chosen openGWAS outcomes found for ", drug)
  } else{
    cat("\n\n")
    cat(knitr::kable(
      chosen_outcomes$openGWAS_studies,
      caption = paste(gsub("_", " ", drug), "Chosen OpenGWAS Outcomes")), 
      sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  cat("\n\n## ", "Drug Targets", "\n\n", sep = "")

  # Drug targets
  targets <- extract_targets(drug)

  if(is.null(targets)){
    cat("No targets found for ", drug)
    next
  } else{
    cat("\n\n")
    cat(knitr::kable(
      targets$targets,
      caption = paste(gsub("_", " ", drug), "Targets")), 
      sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }

  cat("\n\n## ", "MR Results", "\n\n", sep = "")

  # Extract MR results for the chosen outcomes
  mr_res <- extract_MR_result(drug, chosen_outcomes$outcome_ids)

  if(is.null(mr_res)){
    cat("No MR results found for ", drug)
    next
  }

  # Create a plot dataframe
  df <- create_plot_df(mr_res)

  # Create plots for each target gene
  for(g in df$genes){
    
    p <- create_plot(df$plot_df, g, df$snps, df$gene_cols)

    suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(print(p)))

  }

  cat("\n\n## ", "Significant SNP-Outcome Associations", "\n\n", sep = "")

  harmonised_data <- extract_sig_SNP(drug, chosen_outcomes$openGWAS_studies)

  if(is.null(harmonised_data)){
    cat("No significant SNP-Outcome associations found for ", drug, " after multiple testing correction.")
  } else{
    cat("\n\n")
    cat(knitr::kable(
      harmonised_data,
      digits = 100,
      caption = paste0("Significant SNP-Outcome Associations for ", drug)), 
      sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
